jobs.description:
The Talent Acquisition Partner is a hands-on recruiter who manages full-cycle hiring in a high-growth, high-volume environment with tight deadlines, while delivering an exceptional candidate experience. This role supports hiring from intake through offer, including sourcing, workflow management, interview coordination, and hiring decisions. You will partner closely with hiring managers and HR to translate urgent hiring needs into clear recruiting plans and ensure candidates move efficiently and transparently through the process. 
The ideal candidate is comfortable managing a high requisition volume, executing day-to-day recruiting work, prioritizing effectively across multiple roles, exercising sound judgment, and building talent pipelines that support both immediate and future hiring needs. 
This is an Onsite position only. This position will also require travel to our other locations.   
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Hiring Intake 
Partner with hiring managers to confirm hiring needs, role scope, and timelines 
Lead intake meetings to align on role requirements, interview stages, and decision-makers 
Ensure role criteria are job-related, inclusive, and compliant with Swedish labor laws 
Finalize job advertisements and core role documentation 
Advertising & Candidate Attraction 
Publish roles on relevant Swedish and international job boards 
Support employer branding aligned with Swedish workplace values such as transparency, inclusivity, and work–life balance 
Manage inbound applications and ensure timely, transparent candidate communication 
Maintain organized records of job postings and candidate sources 
Application Review & Initial Screening 
Manage a structured review of applications and CVs against predefined, role-specific criteria to ensure consistent, fair evaluation. 
Conduct initial recruiter screening interviews to validate qualifications, role fit, and candidate interest. 
Apply clear candidate dispositions at each stage of the process and ensure all decisions, notes, and outcomes are accurately recorded in the ATS to maintain traceability, reporting accuracy, and audit readiness. 
Onsite Interviews, Feedback & Hiring Decisions 
Manage end-to-end onsite interview logistics, candidate hosting, and day-of coordination 
Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, including greeting, check-in, and interview flow 
Ensure interview spaces, technology, schedules, and documentation are prepared and maintained 
Collect and document structured interview feedback and apply candidate dispositions in the ATS 
Maintain accurate interview records, facilitate evidence-based hiring decisions, and clearly communicate interview outcomes and next steps to candidates 
References, Background Checks & Offers 
Coordinate reference and background checks in line with Swedish norms and candidate consent 
Ensure all references, background check documentation, and consents are accurately recorded 
Partner with HR to prepare employment offers aligned with Swedish market standards 
Manage offer letters, contracts, and related documentation securely 
Support candidates through offer acceptance and handover to onboarding 
Systems, Reporting & Document Management 
Maintain accurate and complete records in the ATS and related HR systems 
Ensure secure storage, access control, and retention of recruitment documents in compliance with GDPR 
Track recruiting metrics such as time-to-hire and candidate experience 
Support audits or internal reviews by providing organized recruitment documentation 
Identify opportunities to improve document workflows, efficiency, and compliance 
Required Qualifications 
Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No 
Direct reports: No 
Authorized to decide on investments according to role and policy 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
7+ years of full-cycle talent acquisition experience in Sweden or the Nordic region, across a combination of agency and in-house/corporate environments 
Proven ability to manage high requisition volumes and engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, using LinkedIn Recruiter, local job boards, referrals, and targeted outreach in fast-paced environments 
Track record of delivering an excellent candidate experience with clear, timely communication 
Experience coordinating interviews, including onsite hiring processes, travel booking, and managing last-minute schedule or logistics changes 
5 years advanced experience with ATS platforms, including dispositioning and GDPR-compliant documentation 
Strong advisory and partnership skills, influencing and collaborating with HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and senior executives on hiring strategy and decision-making 
Bachelor's degree in human resources management or related field. 
Excellent English and Swedish skills both verbally and in writing, additional languages are a plus 

Specific skills: 
Active sourcing 
ATS experience  
Docusign experience  
Experience with Excel  

Personal success factors 
Adaptability – Maintains organization, focus, and process discipline while navigating changing priorities and hiring needs 
Initiative – Proactively identifies hiring needs, gaps, and improvements, taking action without waiting for direction 
Execution Under Pressure – Delivers results in high-volume, deadline-driven environments and manages last-minute changes calmly 
Strategic Partnership & Influence – Acts as a trusted advisor to HRBPs, hiring managers, and executives, influencing decisions with insight and credibility 
Candidate Experience Excellence – Creates a positive, transparent, and respectful experience through clear and timely communication 
Accountability & Proactive Problem Solving – Takes ownership of outcomes, follows through on commitments, and resolves challenges with a positive, can-do attitude

Job Scope
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.
The Instrument Technician is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and compliance of all process instrumentation and measurement systems throughout the manufacturing facility. The technician serves as the technical expert for process control instrumentation, analytical equipment, and measurement devices, ensuring regulatory compliance and optimal process control. They act as the primary resource for instrumentation troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement of measurement systems, guaranteeing that all critical process parameters are accurately monitored and controlled to maintain product quality and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)
·      Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.
·      Perform risk analysis and participate in risk assessments according to established routines.
·      Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time.
·      Troubleshoot and resolve production line issues (mechanical, electrical, automation, process) and completing validation runs of production to confirm the effectiveness of work.
·      Support production teams with first-line problem solving, process optimization, equipment setup and escalation of unresolved technical issues.
·      Perform corrective and preventive maintenance on production equipment (electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic).
·      Install, maintain, and repair equipment, wiring, and systems (mechanical assemblies, electrical systems).
·      Inspect equipment for wear, vibrations, lubrication, or electrical faults and escalate to one level above the need for repair if necessary.
·      Define and manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability.
·      Read and update technical documentation including (but not limited to): diagrams, blueprints, troubleshooting guidelines, checklists and work instructions.
·      Train newly onboarded team members and colleagues in technical and safety procedures.
·      Participate in continuous improvement projects focused on safety, reliability, quality, maintainability and production efficiency.
·      Ensure all work complies with safety standards and regulatory requirements.
·      Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for repairs, troubleshooting, and escalation.
·      Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.
·      Perform equipment and instrumentation commissioning, startup verification, calibration verification and validation runs following maintenance or modification activities.
·      Participate in structured root cause analysis activities for equipment failures, process deviations and quality issues.
·      Collaborate with Quality, Engineering and Maintenance teams to resolve technical issues and improve operational performance.
·      Ensure equipment readiness and availability prior to production startup through inspections, calibration checks and preventive maintenance activities.
·      Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business, including but not limited to running the line, completing 5S, cleaning activities & quality sampling.
 
Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role
Qualifications and Experience
·      Technical/industrial background in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Control Systems, or related field.
·      3+ years previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).
·      Vocational education within Instrumentation Technology, Industrial/Electrical Gymnasium, or equivalent.
·      Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) certification or equivalent is a plus. Six Sigma White or Yellow Belt certification is also advantageous.
·      Experience with calibration management software (EG:Beamx) and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems).
·      Experience troubleshooting transmitters, analyzers, control valves, flow meters, pressure sensors, and temperature devices.
·      Experienced in continuous improvement and root cause analysis.

Specific skills & Knowledge 
·      Proficiency with precision test equipment including multimeters, calibrators, pressure standards, temperature baths, and signal generators.
·      Knowledge of ISO 17025 calibration standards and regulatory compliance requirements.
·      Ability to read and interpret technical documentation including P&IDs, loop diagrams, instrument data sheets, and manufacturer manuals.
·      Basic IT literacy (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with calibration databases or LIMS systems.
·      Understanding of process control principles, loop tuning, and instrumentation optimization for efficient manufacturing operations.
·      Administrative competence, including experience with ERP systems, work orders and incident reporting.
·      Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment.
·      Ability to document technical problems concisely.
·      Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.
·      This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs.

The Opportunity

Our customers are located across the globe, making it essential to understand and stay up to date with country-specific requirements, regulations, and customer agreements. We manage the entire process, from registering the order in SAP to delivering engineering services and materials to both internal and external customers. Your background

Experience working with SAP S/4HANA is required.
Fluency in English is required, while proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantage.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders across the organization.
A proactive and structured approach, with a natural sense of ownership and accountability.
Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong drive for continuous development, with a willingness to embrace new challenges, broaden skills, and contribute to improvements.

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.
Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.
Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?
EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.
In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
The Role
As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.
Your responsibilities will include:
Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
Working in close cooperations with order management team
 Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.
The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.
Is this you?
To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.
In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

jobs.occupation: Systems Architect to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
We Offer
A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product. 
The opportunity to work with new technology and contribute to innovation together with our Jet Printing core development team of 15 specialists across software, mechanics, electronics, configuration management, testing, product management, as well as collaborate with a wide range of functions across the company. 
A culture of innovation and collaboration, working together at our Kista office.

 
Work tasks
As a Systems Architect, you will lead the definition, development, and evolution of robust, scalable, and sustainable system architectures. You will provide the architectural perspective that connects our engineering disciplines and helps translate business and customer needs into technical direction. To do this effectively, you will invest the necessary time to truly understand our products and customers. This includes gaining firsthand experience of their perspective by using our systems during experiments, exploring new opportunities, and developing a deep understanding of how our solutions are used in practice.
Your responsibilities will include:
Lead and align cross-functional technical development, ensuring that software, electronics, mechanics, and mechatronics work together as an integrated system. 
Explore and drive the use of AI to deepen our understanding of the product, identify new opportunities, and improve how we develop and evolve our solutions.
Lead workshops and facilitate discussions around business and technical needs. Balance the overall architectural perspective with the necessary technical details while engaging others in developing concepts that meet customer and product requirements.
Support sales at customer-specific development by performing requirement analyses and product definition.
Establish, develop and share knowledge of current and future manufacturing technologies.

We are looking for
You are a true team player with an open and positive mindset, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to thrive in a global, fast-changing environment. You bring a pragmatic approach to product development, knowing when to push for improvements and when to recognize what already works well. You communicate clearly and effectively with people across different roles and areas of expertise, and take a thoughtful, structured approach to moving work forward, understanding what needs to be done, which competencies are needed, and when to involve the right people.
Furthermore, you have: 
A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Electronics, Mechatronics or similar. 
Solid experience in systems architecture for complex products combining hardware and software.
Solid knowledge of systems engineering, both theoretical and practical. 
Experience translating stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
Strong ability to lead technical discussions and drive decisions.
Experience leading technical projects or product development activities.
Strong communication skills in English.

Knowledge of Swedish.

Are you a results-oriented commercial leader who thrives at the heart of the business?
As Managing Director of Damstahl, you will lead a market-leading sales organisation and hold overall responsibility for sales, market development and financial performance. Your responsibilities will include:
• Identifying new market segments and business opportunities
• Strengthening Damstahl’s market position and developing the product mix in prioritised areas
• Representing Damstahl in business negotiations, industry forums and trade fairs
• Overall responsibility for the company’s operations and performance in 3 Nordic countries
• Ensure that the strategy is translated into specific objectives and action plans.
• Be the culture ambassador and ensure that the organization's structure and capabilities support current and future business needs
You will lead the Swedish, Norwegian and Finnish operations with a clear mandate strategically. You will refer to the Damstahl’s Group CEO. The role involves approximately two days of travel per week, enabling you to remain close to the organisation, the business and market developments.
What we offer
This role is ideal for a leader who wants to develop an organization with a strong sales focus and who is motivated by doing business and creating growth, while benefiting from the long-term perspective and stability of a successful and well-established company.
Damstahl’s ambition is to become one of Europe’s three leading distributors within its field. Its strategy is based on increasing market share, developing the product mix and identifying new areas of growth. Digitalization is an important part of Damstahl’s strategy and customer offering. Damstahl has a fully developed webshop, EDI and ERP integrations, and also offers AI-based services.
Who are you?
You are a results-oriented commercial leader who wants to stay close to the business. You understand how warehousing and logistics contribute to commercial success and can demonstrate, through documented results, that you have created profitable growth as a Sales Director or Managing Director within B2B—preferably in an industrial business with warehousing operations.
You have a strong ability to turn plans into action and can analyze market developments and the competitive landscape, translating these insights into clear commercial priorities. Experience from steel, metals, technical distribution or a related industrial sector is a significant advantage. Knowledge of tubes, fittings and flanges is particularly valuable, as this is a key area for growth. Fluency in spoken and written English and Swedish is required.
About Damstahl
Damstahl AB’s head office is located in Malmö, with sales offices in Gothenburg and Stockholm. The company also has a sales office in Norway and sales representation in Finland. Whilst the Damstahl Group has its headquarter in Skanderborg, Denmark.
Damstahl is part of the NEUMO Ehrenberg Group, a family-owned industrial group with approximately 2,250 employees and annual revenue of around EUR 800 million.
· Damstahl Group generates revenue of approximately EUR 350 million
· The Group has around 290 employees
· More than 70,000 tonnes of stainless steel are distributed annually
· Warehousing and distribution capacity is located in Denmark, Sweden and Norway
Damstahl’s competitive strength is built on extensive product expertise, high availability and a comprehensive Nordic and European warehousing and distribution network. We offer a broad and extensive range of stainless steel products, including sheets, bars, tubes, fittings and flanges. Through the Group, the offering also includes aluminium and other metals.
The Skanderborg facility includes an automated high-bay warehouse with capacity for approximately 10,000 tonnes of stainless steel The extensive warehousing structure ensures high product availability and short lead times across the Nordic markets. 
The Malmö facility includes a fully automated warehouse with the capacity of 4 400 m/2. The operation running from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM with a total staff of five, plus three people handling logistics and returns, along with a Team Leader for that group. https://www.damstahl.com/sv/
Application
Damstahl is collaborating with Charlotte Olsson at Insikta AB on this recruitment. If you have any questions, please contact Charlotte Olsson on +46 70 602 19 11 or at charlotte@insikta.se.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. Naturally, all enquiries and applications will be treated confidentially. To apply, simply submit your CV together with a brief explanation of why you are interested in the role.

Why Doktor.se
Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.
We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.
What you'll do
Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.
Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.
What we're looking for
You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack
Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)
Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS
IaC - Terraform
CI/CD - GitHub Actions
Languages - Python, TypeScript
AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)
Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)
What we offer
Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details
Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.

Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.

Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technology

We handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 

A Vision Automation Engineer in a cell manufacturing company plays a key role in developing, optimizing, reverse-engineering, and maintaining machine vision and optical inspection systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. They are responsible for programming, troubleshooting, and improving cameras, lighting configurations, and image processing algorithms, supporting both legacy production line re-commissioning and new vision system installations. The role also includes ensuring accurate data transfer, system connectivity, and smooth communication with PLCs, SCADA, and upper-level MES platforms to enable inline defect traceability, dimensional inspection, and digital integration. Close collaboration with production, engineering, and maintenance teams is required to identify and implement solutions that improve quality, throughput, and equipment uptime. A strong focus is placed on continuous improvement, safety, and scalability to meet the growing demand for electric vehicle battery production. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 
Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards relating to equipment control and programming.  
Responsible for the FATs of the equipment (Project timeline dependent).  
Lead vision system integration and optical calibration during equipment commissioning and line re-starts (Project timeline dependent). 
Develop and reverse-engineer the vision inspection systems to be implemented in the production and logistics equipment in the factory, as well as the relevant specifications and documentation. 
Author and review engineering design documentation (Specifications, Functional design, Logic diagrams, Test Cases, Test Records).  
Train and mentor new engineers, and educate other support functions on machine vision, optics, and quality inspection gates. 
Code review and test of suppliers' vision software and algorithmic work within the projects to validate specified defect detection thresholds (Gauge R&R) and to ensure the quality and reliability of the data transferred from the equipment to the upper-level systems. 
Participate in R&D activities for piloting of new technologies and their suitability to production environments. 
Define and improve the factory blueprint, general specifications and ways of working in collaboration with the extended automation and digitalization teams. (Project timeline dependent). 
Contribute to technical improvements, development and optimization of software processes internally in the automation team 
The role requires regular presence on the production floor, with a minimum of approximately 25% of working hours spent on-site. Depending on project needs (such as line re-commissioning), there may be periods where up to 100% of working hours are required on the shop floor. 
Develop and maintain machine vision and image processing programming standards. 
Guide and mentor colleagues to industrial best practices, focussing on growth and development. 
Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resource for the benefit of the business. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Qualifications and Experience 
Bachelors Degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Software Engineering or similar. 
Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience within Industrial Automation in process-driven or discrete manufacturing industries such as: Battery Cell, Automotive, Chemical, Paper, Semiconductors, Pharma, Food, Warehouses, etc. 
Experience of working with industrial camera systems, optical components, and lighting techniques, including the selection, configuration, and calibration of camera hardware for manufacturing inspection and process control applications 
Experience in the design, configuration, and deployment of machine vision systems including cameras, lighting, and vision software platforms such as Cognex, Halcon, or equivalent, with experience integrating vision outputs into PLC, SCADA, and MES environments via OPC connectivity. 
Experience developing and optimising image processing pipelines and vision algorithms for applications such as defect detection, pattern recognition, and dimensional verification, with familiarity with industrial communication protocols for vision system integration. 
Experience in writing technical documentation including inspection requirement specifications, algorithm validation reports, vision system configuration records, functional design, UML, test cases, and test records. 
Experience with image processing software and programming tools relevant to industrial vision applications, such as Python, C++, OpenCV, or equivalent vision libraries, with the ability to develop, test, and optimise vision algorithms for real-time manufacturing environments 
Experienced continuous improvement and root cause analysis. 

Specific skills 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for manufacturing systems. 
Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.

Job Title: PSIRT Operational Specialist
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let's make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
Role Summary

Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the future of secure and sustainable transportation. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems.
This role combines both operational and tactical responsibilities. You will collaborate with experts across Vehicle Security Operations, Cybersecurity Testing, Product Development, Safety, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure the highest level of cybersecurity resilience throughout the product lifecycle.
If you are passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to contribute to products that impact millions of people worldwide, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
 
Job Responsibilities

As a PSIRT Operational Specialist, you will:
· Analyze cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks, including assessment of CVEs, CPEs, and CVSS scores, as well as disclosure management.
· Contribute to, and when ready coordinate or lead, cross-functional incident triage, forensic investigations, and response activities.
· Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PSIRT playbooks, security procedures, and incident readiness plans.
· Configure, validate, and support our security tools and technologies.
· Support in compliance activities related to cybersecurity regulations and standards such as ISO 21434 and UNECE R155.
· Stay informed about emerging cyber threats, technology trends, and industry developments to proactively develop our security capabilities.
 
Who You Are

You are a driven and proactive cybersecurity professional who thrives in a technical environment and enjoys collaborating across teams, functions, and cultures. You can balance tactical thinking with hands-on execution and remain calm in critical situations.
We believe you have:
· Experience from cybersecurity operations, incident response, vulnerability analysis, PSIRT, SOC, or automotive cybersecurity environments.
· A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
· Experience from evaluating security risks, threats, or vulnerabilities.
· A structured and detail-oriented approach combined with strong integrity and professionalism.
· Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
· And, a strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats
 
It is a plus if you have:
· Experience from working with automotive EE systems, connected vehicles, or embedded systems software.
· Knowledge of ISO 21434, UNECE R155, CRA, digital forensics, or threat intelligence.
· Security certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, or CompTIA Security+.
· Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar.
 
This Is Us

We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork.
Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company's cybersecurity status.
 
Who Is Your Manager
I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. I believe in creating a safe, transparent, and collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better solutions.
Our work is challenging yet meaningful, which is why I prioritize trust, teamwork, and personal development and growth. Just as important, I value work-life balance and the well-being of every individual in the team.
 
Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. 

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
Jenny Holmqvist, Manager in CS Monitoring & Incident Response jenny.holmqvist@scania.com.

We look forward to your application!

Define and evolve H&M’s Security Architecture, target state and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities, technology strategy and cyber risk appetite.
Establish reusable security principles, standards and reference architectures 
Drive secure-by-design and secure-by-default practices by translating security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical guardrails, patterns and automated controls for product, platform and engineering teams.
Guide the development of H&M’s modern Cyber Defense Architecture, strengthening capabilities for prevention, detection, response, recovery, security observability and automation.
Shape and evolve the AI Security Architecture together with Security, Enterprise Architecture, AI and Data, Privacy and Risk teams, enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across H&M.
Act as a subject matter expert on AI security, advising stakeholders on AI-related risks, governance, controls, data protection, secure architecture patterns and emerging threats.
Identify and drive the security capabilities, products and services needed to enable secure AI adoption, modern engineering practices and scalable digital innovation.
Lead resolution of complex cross-domain security architecture challenges, including identity boundaries, privileged access, cloud and workload protection, network segmentation and shared security services.
Partner with technology leaders to ensure security architecture enables resilient, compliant and trusted digital products and services.

WHO YOU ARE

10+ years of experience across information security, architecture, engineering or related technology roles.

Experience with security observability, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, security automation and continuous control monitoring.

Experience developing enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, reference architectures, standards and roadmaps that can be adopted across multiple domains and product teams.

Ability to solve complex, cross-domain architecture challenges and guide technology transformation that enables new digital opportunities and business models.
A strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the ability to connect security architecture decisions with business strategy, digital products, platforms and the wider technology landscape.
Experience leading, coaching and developing architecture or engineering teams, while influencing stakeholders beyond direct reporting lines.

 Role Summary
 
We are looking for a Process Manager Data Management & People Analytics to strengthen how People data and analytics support business decisions within our assigned Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities.  
In this business-oriented role, you will connect business needs with global P&C processes, data governance and analytics capabilities. Working from a dual perspective, you will support the adoption of global standards within our Business Areas while contributing to the priorities of the Finance and P&C Communities. As part of the Cross Area Team, you will also contribute to broader initiatives where your expertise adds value, adapting to changing business needs and priorities. 
 
Job Responsibilities
Your main responsibilities will include:
 
Connect business needs with data and People analytics: Identify opportunities where People Analytics can improve decision-making and translate business needs into data, reporting and analytics requirements. 
Strengthen data quality and governance: Support the adoption of global P&C processes, data standards and definitions. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, clarify ownership and resolve issues through established governance channels. 
Enable self-service and data-driven ways of working: Guide and train stakeholders in using trusted People data, analytics tools and insights in everyday decisions. 
Drive collaboration, change and adoption: Work across business functions, P&C and specialist teams to facilitate discussions, build alignment and support sustainable behavioural change. 
Support AI-related transformation: Help turn AI capabilities into practical business value, supporting adoption and contributing to the team's AI upskilling journey. 

Enable actionable insights: Support the development and use of People Analytics, reports and dashboards to help stakeholders understand trends and make informed decisions.
 
Who You Are
We believe you are an experienced P&C professional with a background in similar business-facing roles or P&C Business Partnering, combining broad P&C understanding with Data Management & People Analytics capabilities. 
You enjoy working close to the business, navigating organisational complexity and turning People data into meaningful insights and business value. You build strong stakeholder relationships and thrive in a changing environment where priorities evolve. 
We believe you also bring: 
Proven experience with HR data, People Analytics, data governance, reporting, business intelligence or HR process management. 
Good understanding of data management principles, including governance, stewardship, data quality, ownership and accessibility. 
Ability to identify analytics opportunities, translate business needs into actionable insights, and perform basic analysis, reporting and visualisation. 
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with experience supporting change and adoption. 
Fluency in written and spoken English. 
A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Management, Analytics, Information Systems or a related field. 

Experience with self-service analytics, digital transformation or AI-related change would be an advantage.
 
This Is Us
 You will join a collaborative team within P&C Enabling Functions, working across organisational boundaries and close to the business. 
Our team works close to the business, connecting business needs with P&C expertise and turning strategic priorities into practical results. We value collaboration, flexibility and the ability to navigate organisational complexity and changing priorities. 
The role offers an opportunity to combine your P&C experience with Data Management & People Analytics, contribute to better business decisions and help develop more effective, data-driven ways of working within our Business Areas and the Finance and P&C Communities. 
We encourage curiosity, continuous learning and the willingness to explore how AI and new technologies can create business value.
 
Scania Offers
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
The role
You will lead the Decisioning squad as its most senior data scientist: data scientists, ML engineers, and backend engineers across Stockholm and India, reporting to the Associate Director, Revenue Intelligence, in Stockholm.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will still write models, run the offline evaluations, and read the experiment results yourself. You will also set the modelling direction for the squad, decide which problems are worth solving next, and hold the bar on how a model earns its way into production.
The work has a direct commercial edge. The squad's models decide which ads run and at what price on Truecaller's largest ad surfaces, so a better model shows up in revenue within weeks. The next step is to move from choosing the campaign to setting the bid: one decision that combines a calibrated conversion probability with price, pacing and frequency.
What you'll do
Own the modelling roadmap for decisioning - conversion prediction, ranking, campaign selection and bidding - and agree it with product and engineering.
Design, build and run production models end to end, from problem framing and features through offline evaluation, A/B tests and monitoring.
Evolve the contextual bandit from choosing which campaign to show to setting a per-request bid, with exploration, off-policy evaluation and safe rollout built in.
Keep model scores honest: calibration per campaign and placement, and a clear link between offline metrics and the revenue and conversions advertisers actually see.
Set the bar for experimentation in the squad: every model change ships with a holdout, an agreed success metric, and a clear ship or kill rule.
Lead the squad: set the technical direction, review designs and code, run the prioritisation, and grow the data scientists, engineers and interns around you. You are accountable for what the squad ships, not only for your own work.
Write the RFCs and decision records the group works from, and present results and trade-offs to product, commercial and executive leadership.
Work with backend and data engineering on serving latency, feature pipelines and data quality, so models run reliably at very high throughput.
Raise the data science practice across Revenue Intelligence and the wider discipline through reviews, shared methods and mentoring.

What you bring in
7+ years in data science or applied machine learning, including several years owning models in production that real revenue depends on.
Depth in ranking, recommendation, or conversion prediction at scale - multi-task learning, deep learning, gradient-boosted models, and calibration.
Hands-on experience with online learning or decision systems, such as contextual bandits, exploration strategies, and off-policy evaluation.
Strong experimentation skills: A/B test design, power, causal reasoning, and telling a real lift from noise.
Expert Python and SQL, with a modern deep learning framework (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch) and a cloud warehouse at real scale. We run on GCP and BigQuery; equivalent depth on another stack transfers.
Technical leadership of a team: setting direction, reviewing other people's work, and raising the quality of the people around you.
Strong written English. You will write the RFCs, evaluation reports, and design docs, and they will be read by people who were not in the room.
Comfort operating across Stockholm and India time zones.

It would be great if you also have
Ad tech experience - real-time bidding, auctions, pacing, attribution or campaign delivery.
Experience with the India digital advertising market and performance advertisers.
An MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.
Experience taking models to low-latency serving, and the MLOps around it: model registries, monitoring and automated retraining.
Exposure to privacy-constrained modelling, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.
Experience applying LLMs to modelling or analysis work.

The research group focuses on improving diagnostics and advancing our understanding of central nervous system (CNS) tumours through epigenetic and molecular approaches. Our research particularly focuses on DNA methylation profiling, nanopore sequencing, and the analysis of patient-derived samples, including liquid biopsies. We combine advanced sequencing technologies with bioinformatic method development and multiomics analyses to develop new diagnostic and prognostic tools and gain deeper insights into tumour biology. Close collaborations with pathologists, neurosurgeons, and oncologists at Sahlgrenska University Hospital support the group's strong translational research focus. 
Duties 
We are seeking an experienced and independent researcher with strong expertise in bioinformatics and a particular interest in computational method development within cancer research. The position focuses on developing and applying advanced bioinformatic methods for sequencing data analysis, with particular emphasis on nanopore sequencing, epigenetic modifications, liquid biopsy, and integrated multiomics analyses.
The successful candidate is expected to independently develop novel computational methods and bioinformatic pipelines and contribute to the design and execution of research projects within the group.
Responsibilities include:
Independent development, implementation, and optimisation of bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines for large-scale sequencing data.
Development of analytical methods for DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing data, including the identification and quantification of DNA methylation and other nucleic acid modifications.
Development and application of bioinformatic methods for liquid biopsy analysis, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), using nanopore sequencing and enzymatic methyl-seq (EM-seq).
Development of computational approaches for the analysis of RNA modifications from sequencing data.
Integration of genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data through advanced multiomics analyses.
Development of robust and reproducible computational pipelines, including evaluation and validation of novel analytical methods.
Independent statistical analysis, visualisation, and biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Scientific responsibility for the bioinformatic aspects of research projects, including study design, methodological decisions, data interpretation, and scientific publication.
Collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers, as well as supervision of junior researchers and students in bioinformatics.

 
Qualifications 
Required qualifications
PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or another relevant discipline with a strong computational focus.
Several years of documented experience in independent bioinformatic research and computational method development.
Extensive expertise in the analysis of large-scale sequencing data, particularly DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing.
Documented experience in developing and implementing bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines.
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of DNA methylation and other epigenetic modifications.
Experience in the analysis of liquid biopsy data, RNA modifications, and/or integrated multiomics datasets.
Excellent programming skills, for example in Python and R, and experience working in Linux-based computational environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, conduct, and lead bioinformatic research projects.
A strong scientific publication record in relevant research areas.
Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

Meriting qualifications
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of liquid biopsy data using nanopore sequencing and EM-seq.
Experience in developing methods for identifying RNA modifications from nanopore-based direct RNA sequencing.
In-depth knowledge of epigenetics, DNA methylation, and epigenetic tumour classification.
Research experience in CNS tumours or other areas of cancer research.
Experience in integrating genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic datasets.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC), version control, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience in translational research and the development of bioinformatic methods for diagnostic applications.

jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit
